name: detectai-payment-gateway (loadtest)
description: Load-test view for payment-gateway (deployment.environment = loadtest): k6-driven webhook/internal traffic plus collector infra. service.name = payment-gateway. Kept widget-for-widget in sync with payment-gateway prod (only the environment filter differs).

pages.name: Payment gateway
pages.description: Webhook RED, HMAC validation, MQ publish, Go runtime, containers

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `rpm` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'SERVER'
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'SERVER'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' AND http.route = '/webhook/paddle'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 99) AS `p99 ms` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' AND http.route = '/webhook/paddle'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' FACET `http.route` TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `rpm` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' FACET `http.route` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' FACET `http.status_code` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`payment_webhook_signatures_invalid_total`), 1 minute) AS `invalid signatures/min`, rate(sum(`payment_webhooks_unknown_event_type_total`), 1 minute) AS `unknown types/min`, rate(sum(`payment_internal_events_unauthorized_total`), 1 minute) AS `unauthorized/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`payment_webhook_body_errors_total`), 1 minute) AS `body errors/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET reason TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 5
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`payment_events_published_total`), 1 minute) AS `events/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET status TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 5

FROM Metric SELECT average(`rabbitmq_connection_status`) AS `connected`, rate(sum(`rabbitmq_reconnections_total`), 1 minute) AS `reconnects/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES 1 minute

FROM Metric SELECT average(`rabbitmq_publish_duration_seconds`) * 1000 AS `publish avg ms`, average(`payment_signature_validation_duration_seconds`) * 1000 AS `hmac avg ms` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Metric SELECT average(`go_goroutines`) AS goroutines WHERE service = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.cpu.utilization`) AS `cpu` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%payment-gateway%' TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.memory.percent`) AS `mem` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%payment-gateway%' TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`container.network.io.usage.rx_bytes`), 1 minute) AS rx WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%payment-gateway%' TIMESERIES 1 minute
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`container.network.io.usage.tx_bytes`), 1 minute) AS tx WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%payment-gateway%' TIMESERIES 1 minute

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`container.cpu.throttling_data.throttled_time`), 1 minute) AS `throttled ns/s` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%payment-gateway%' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`container.cpu.utilization`) AS `cpu %` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%payment-gateway%'
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`container.memory.percent`) AS `mem %` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE '%payment-gateway%'
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`rabbitmq_connection_status`) AS `connected` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest'

FROM Span SELECT max(duration.ms) AS `max ms`, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms`, count(*) WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' FACET `http.route` LIMIT 20
FROM Span SELECT count(*) AS spans FACET service.name, service.version WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service.name = 'payment-gateway' LIMIT 20

pages.name: Logs
pages.description: Error-first log stream plus volume and slow requests

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT timestamp, `severity.text`, message, `http.route`, `trace.id` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `severity.text` = 'ERROR' LIMIT 100

widgets.title: Log volume by level (click legend to isolate) (load)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET `severity.text` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `severity.text` = 'ERROR' FACET `http.route` TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n, latest(message) AS sample, latest(`trace.id`) AS `sample trace` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `severity.text` = 'ERROR' FACET `http.route` LIMIT 20

FROM Span SELECT timestamp, name, `http.route`, duration.ms, `http.status_code`, `trace.id` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' AND duration.ms > 500 LIMIT 100
